rationale: Both applicable lenses (edge-case, acceptance) and the standards audit ran clean with no blocking findings, and all business/spec criteria pass except one pending-stage-7 full-suite confirmation, which is not a failure. Of 3 edge-case candidates, 2 were dismissed after verification (the disconnect path correctly persists in_progress=true for genuine interruptions by design; finalize_thoughts' children-type risk never triggers because AgentInvokeCallback-derived children are always empty in the current code) and 1 pre-existing hedged-coordinator timeout gap (queue.Empty branch never calls save_chat_history) is deferred as out of this change's scope — see code-review-deferred.md.
